track: Open Weight AI & Open Source Tools
title: Migrant Worker Wage-Theft Evidence Builder
Description: Seasonal and migrant construction workers frequently face wage theft with no formal record to prove it. Build a simple, offline-first tool where a worker logs daily attendance and hours worked — a voice note in their own language is enough — and an open-weight speech and language model transcribes, structures, and compiles these logs into a legally-usable wage-claim document, comparing the logged hours against the applicable state's minimum wage notification.
Tools & Technologies: Open-weight speech-to-text (Whisper — open-weight versions, or Vosk for fully offline use); open-weight LLM for structuring transcripts into a claim document (small models for on-device use); local-first storage (SQLite); backend with Node.js/Express, FastAPI, or Spring Boot; React or Angular for a lightweight, mobile-friendly interface that works with minimal connectivity.
